name: Resticker Utah 2019
information:
Cubes will be sold at the competition by Oliver's Twisted Puzzles. 
There is a 100 person competitor limit, so don't wait too long to register.
There will be a mystery event.  See the [tab on the Mystery Event for more information!](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RestickerUtah2019#10732-mystery-event)
As always, make sure you are familiar with all the regulations.
If you are new to competing, You may want to check out this competitor tutorial video. 
youtube(https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)
